name: palworld-timelapse-render
description: Node dependencies for timelapse.mjs, the headless render driver. Kept as a manifest rather than a symlink into the scratch volume so a checkout can recreate it: tools/timelapse/bootstrap.sh runs npm install here. No 'type' field on purpose - timelapse.mjs is ESM by its .mjs extension, and buildorder.js must stay CommonJS.
